text: On the same set of 120 queries in an offline English retrieval evaluation, the baseline made 11 errors and the adapted method made 8 errors. Median latency was 310 ms for the baseline and 345 ms for the adapted method. No statistical significance testing was performed, and neither multilingual performance nor online operation was evaluated.
The estimator is consistent under Assumption A. We report the mean absolute error over 5 independent runs. The result does not establish optimality outside the evaluated class.
These observations suggest that the adapted method may reduce errors on this dataset, but the effect has not been tested online.
